verdict.rationale: Marqeta docs show the building blocks for tightly scoped cards — instant virtual card issuance (docs-12/16), merchant-restriction authorization controls (docs-6/21), and velocity/amount spending caps (docs-5/26) — and cards can be transitioned to inactive/terminated via the card-transitions endpoint (docs-29), which together let a developer approximate a one-purchase, one-merchant, exact-amount card. However, there is no explicit first-party 'single-use card' or auto-expire-after-one-transaction feature documented; it must be assembled from separate controls rather than a native single-use mode. Missing for 10: an explicit single-use/auto-expiring card primitive, and independent/hands-on confirmation that combining these controls reliably enforces exactly one transaction.
